title: Canyon Overdrive - an AI assisted game made with Astra
author: TheMarco
selftext:
I have been at this for about 5 days now. Started out as a simple demo but grew into a full blown arcade game with many configurable options. It even has fully configurable controller / game pad support.

Every level has its own special event. Lots of enemy types and other cool things.

Play it here: [https://canyonoverdrive.ai-created.com](https://canyonoverdrive.ai-created.com)

On mobile the best experience is to "save to home screen" and it will work like a native app.

This is totally free by the way so I did not flair "commercial self promotion". If this is in error, mods, let me know!
